conceptZh: 兔子魔術師想變出五朵花，兩邊拉扯的魔術彩帶把五的筆畫拉成形。
object: a cartoon magician rabbit in a top hat with a long magic ribbon
morph: two ends of a tugged ribbon spring tight into the strokes of 五
creativeAngle: 用魔術彩帶拔河：兔子與帽子裡的東西各拉一端，彈回來時剛好拼成五，最後帽子噴出五個月亮造型的小點心呼應五月。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright, cheerful animated clip on a soft butter-yellow stage with a pale cream backdrop. A plump cartoon magician rabbit in a purple top hat and tiny bow tie stands left of center. Off-screen narrator, warm clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slowly and distinctly with clear tones, says exactly: 「五、五、五月」 (ㄨˇ、ㄨˇ、ㄨˇ ㄩㄝˋ) and then stops. Read exactly these syllables.
0.0-1.8s: The rabbit whips a rainbow ribbon out of his hat; the ribbon is stuck, so he braces and pulls while the hat itself seems to pull back, hat sliding across the floor. First utterance 「五」 (ㄨˇ) as the tug starts.
1.8-3.6s: Tug-of-war escalates: the rabbit's ears stretch, the hat hops backward, the ribbon stretches into a long taut line. Second 「五」 (ㄨˇ) lands as the ribbon SNAPS tight and springs into the four strokes of one deep-teal glyph 五, strokes saturated solid teal against the pale backdrop, the glyph filling about 70% of frame height.
3.6-5.0s: The rabbit tumbles backward in a harmless somersault; out of the hat float five little crescent moons, one by one, arcing over the glyph. The word 「五月」 (ㄨˇ ㄩㄝˋ) is spoken exactly as the five moons pop out.
5.0-8.0s: Final 3-second hold: the glyph 五 stays perfectly still, centered, uncropped, readable. The rabbit sits up beside it, hat crooked, tips it proudly and wiggles his ears, never touching the strokes; the moons twinkle gently away from the glyph.
Only the single glyph 五 appears as text; no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing. Soft music, quieter than the voice.
